title: Bump version to 0.3.4
body:
Patch release for protocol improvements and window functions support.

## Changes

- **Version**: Bumped all packages from `0.3.3` → `0.3.4`
- **Packages updated**: 
  - Core: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/types`
  - Infrastructure: `@objectstack/driver-memory`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/cli`
  - Examples: Updated all example applications
- **Changelogs**: Generated via changesets with release date 2026-01-27

## Release

Ready to publish via `pnpm run release` after merge.
